description: A utility class providing methods for handling HTTP responses and errors within a Vert.x web application, including setting response bodies, handling errors, and extracting headers.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: A final class containing static utility methods for processing HTTP requests and responses, error handling, and header extraction in a Vert.x web context.

methods.name: badRequest
methods.description: Fails a routing context with HTTP 400 Bad Request, optionally with a message.

methods.name: internalServerError
methods.description: Fails a routing context with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, optionally with a message.

methods.name: serviceUnavailable
methods.description: Fails a routing context with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, setting Retry-After header.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Fails a routing context with HTTP 401 Unauthorized, setting WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a given ServiceInvocationException.

methods.name: failWithHeaders
methods.description: Fails a routing context with a given error and optional headers, setting headers on the response.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Type header value from a RoutingContext.

methods.name: isEmptyNotification
methods.description: Checks if the request contains an empty notification based on Content-Type.

methods.name: getTimeTillDisconnect
methods.description: Extracts the 'Time Till Disconnect' header or query parameter as an Integer.

methods.name: getTimeToLive
methods.description: Extracts the 'Time To Live' header or query parameter as a Duration.

methods.name: getCommandResponseStatus
methods.description: Extracts the 'Command Response Status' header or query parameter as an Optional<Integer>.

methods.name: setResponseBody
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write JSON arrays, JSON objects, or Buffers to the HTTP response, setting headers accordingly.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code is an error (400-599).
